2026/09/11 (040-041)
回归舒适区！还是单张的画的爽，这次尝试了下4096x4096，我和电脑都燃尽了，如果喜欢记得看原图，其他图也是，网站默认的是重新采样的图，和原图看起来还是不一样的。

Back to my comfort zone! Single images are still way more fun to make. Tried 4096×4096 this time, and both my PC and I are completely burnt out lol. If you like it, make sure to check out the original image! Same goes for my other works. The site displays a resampled version by default, which can look different from the original.
